title: Expro celebrates Gulf Energy Information Excellence Awards success

body_markdown:
Expro has reinforced its position at the forefront of energy technology innovation by winning *Best Controls, Instrumentation, Automation Technology – Upstream* at the Gulf Energy Information Excellence Awards for its iTONG™, the industry’s most technologically advanced autonomous connection make-up and validation systems.


The awards attracted a record 560 nominations, with 44 awards presented across the upstream, midstream and downstream sectors.


The recognition follows eight finalist nominations spanning completions, controls and automation, deepwater, digital transformation, health, safety and the environment, pipeline integrity, and production technology.


iTONG™, part of Expro’s Auton™ solutions, automates the make-up and break-out of casing and tubing connections at the push of a single button. Operated remotely from the driller’s cabin, the system provides precise torque control and full connection validation while eliminating the need for personnel to work in the hazardous Red Zone of the rig floor. This helps improve safety, well integrity and operational efficiency.


Auton™ brings together automation, mechanization, remote control and Expro’s expert oversight to help reduce personnel exposure while maintaining operational control. It is designed to create safer, more controlled and efficient working environments by engineering exposure out of tasks wherever possible.


Expro entered the awards as a finalist in the following categories:


- **Best Completions Technology** — Remote Clamp Installation System (RCIS)
- **Best Controls, Instrumentation, Automation Technology – Upstream** — iTONG™
- **Best Deepwater Technology** — ONEFIT™ (Caseless Insertable)
- **Best Deepwater Technology** — VERSAFLO™ NXT
- **Best Digital Transformation – Upstream** — Centri-Fi™
- **Best Health, Safety or Environmental Contribution – Upstream** — Spring ARK
- **Best Pipeline Integrity Technology** — Velonix®
- **Best Production Technology** — QPulse™


Jeremy Angelle, Vice President of Well Construction at Expro, said: “Winning this award is a tremendous achievement and reflects our commitment to using intelligent automation to take people out of the Red Zone without taking expertise out of the operation. As part of our Auton™ solutions, iTONG™ demonstrates how technology and expert oversight combines to deliver safer, more precise and efficient well construction.


“To have eight technologies recognized across such a broad range of categories demonstrates the strength of our innovation portfolio. We are proud of the people behind these solutions and grateful to our customers and partners who continue to collaborate with us.”


The awards celebrate excellence and innovation across the energy industry. Expro’s success underlines the company’s continued focus on developing practical technologies that support safer operations, stronger performance and the evolving needs of customers.
